attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file West Virginia state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus ($100K or 200 transactions).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in WV (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "WV" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets WV economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "WV" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: add "WV filing required due to physical presence. Reference: WV Code 11-24-7" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "WV filing required due to physical presence. Reference: WV Code 11-24-7" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_dsl: add "WV filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100K OR 200 transactions. Reference: WV Code 11-24-7" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "WV filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100K OR 200 transactions. Reference: WV Code 11-24-7" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No WV nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No WV nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No WV nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate WV state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate WV state additions and subtractions; Calculate WV-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "WV income adjustments calculated. Reference: WV Code 11-24-6" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "WV income adjustments calculated. Reference: WV Code 11-24-6" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No WV nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "No WV nexus - no adjustments calculated." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No WV nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate WV state corporate income tax. Applies WV 6.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate WV tax at 6.5% flat rate; WV income tax at 6.5% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * wv_apportionment.state_tax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "WV tax calculated at 6.5% flat rate. Single-sales factor effective 2022+. Reference: WV Code 11-24-4, 11-24-7" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income wv_apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "WV tax calculated at 6.5% flat rate. Single-sales factor effective 2022+. Reference: WV Code 11-24-4, 11-24-7" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No WV nexus - no tax liability; No WV nexus - no tax
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No WV nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No WV nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income; No WV taxable income - no tax
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No WV taxable income - no tax. WV NOL rules apply (separate from federal). Reference: WV Code 11-24-6" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No WV taxable income - no tax. WV NOL rules apply (separate from federal). Reference: WV Code 11-24-6" job.audit_trail swap addto
